Experiments to try one at a time. Each stays off until you turn it on, and turning it off removes it from your windows at once. The ones that use AI ask your own assistant on this computer, only when you click.

Your assistants

The Lab runs Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity as installed on this computer, whatever their version, after checking the options it uses. Checking starts each one without sending anything.

AI on the page

Two takes on one idea. One can be on at a time.

What's wrong here: it looks right away

When you capture an area of one of your projects' pages, your own AI proposes up to three concrete next steps for your agent.

How to try
Open a page of one of your projects, such as Harbor.
Hold the right mouse button and drag over something that looks wrong.
Pick one of the proposals: it becomes your agent's task.

Experimental. Uses Claude Code or Codex on this computer when you click.

Click What's wrong here? in the bar.
Pick one of the proposals: it becomes your agent's task.

Agents

Agents as tabs in a folder

Each space gets a Zen live folder Agents where every agent session of its projects is a tab that says what it does and opens its result.

How to try
Start a task for one of your projects, such as Harbor, here or in Claude Code in your terminal.
Watch its tab in the Agents folder of that project's space.
Click it when it is done: its page opens with the result.
